class.name: TOML
class.brief_description: Reads and writes TOML, and any [Resource] as a TOML file.
class.description:
[TOML] reads and writes [url=https://toml.io/en/v1.0.0]TOML 1.0[/url] documents, a configuration format that is easy for people to read and edit. A document is read into a [Dictionary] whose keys keep the order of the file; tables become nested [Dictionary]s, arrays and arrays of tables become [Array]s. The module also registers a loader and a saver for the file extension [code].toml[/code], so any [Resource] can be saved and loaded as TOML with [method ResourceSaver.save] and [method ResourceLoader.load]. It uses the same property mapping as the JSON format of [ResourceTextSerializer]: the root table has the keys [code]"$type"[/code] and [code]"$format_version"[/code], followed by one key per stored property. Nested resources are sub-tables ([code][main][/code]), arrays of resources are arrays of tables ([code][[entries]][/code]). The module also implements [constant ResourceTextSerializer.FORMAT_TOML], so [code]ResourceTextSerializer.serialize(resource, ResourceTextSerializer.FORMAT_TOML)[/code] and [method ResourceTextSerializer.deserialize] work with TOML like with the built-in formats. [codeblocks] [gdscript] var settings = AudioBusSettings.new() # A Resource with class_name AudioBusSettings. settings.master_volume = 0.8 ResourceSaver.save(settings, "user://audio.toml") var loaded = ResourceLoader.load("user://audio.toml") as AudioBusSettings print(loaded.master_volume) # Prints 0.8
# Any TOML document as a Dictionary: var toml = TOML.new() if toml.parse("[window]
width = 1280
") == OK: print(toml.get_data()["window"]["width"]) # Prints 1280 else: print("Line %d: %s" % [toml.get_error_line(), toml.get_error_message()]) [/gdscript] [csharp] var settings = new AudioBusSettings(); // A [GlobalClass] Resource. settings.MasterVolume = 0.8f; ResourceSaver.Save(settings, "user://audio.toml"); var loaded = ResourceLoader.Load<AudioBusSettings>("user://audio.toml"); GD.Print(loaded.MasterVolume); // Prints 0.8
// Any TOML document as a Dictionary: var toml = new Toml(); if (toml.Parse("[window]
width = 1280
") == Error.Ok) { GD.Print(toml.GetData()["window"].AsGodotDictionary()["width"]); // Prints 1280 } else { GD.Print($"Line {toml.GetErrorLine()}: {toml.GetErrorMessage()}"); } [/csharp] [/codeblocks] A resource file looks like this: [codeblock lang=text] "$type" = "AudioBusSettings" "$format_version" = 1 master_volume = 0.8 mode = "Stereo"
[[buses]] name = "Music" volume = 0.5 [/codeblock] [b]Reading:[/b] all of TOML 1.0 is supported: tables, dotted keys, arrays of tables, inline tables, basic, literal and multi-line strings, integers in decimal, hexadecimal ([code]0x[/code]), octal ([code]0o[/code]) and binary ([code]0b[/code]), floats including [code]inf[/code] and [code]nan[/code], booleans and comments. Dates and times have no [Variant] type and are returned as [String]s, as written in the file. Errors stop the parsing and are reported with line and column. [b]Writing:[/b] keys keep their order. In each table the plain keys come first, then its sub-tables and arrays of tables, because TOML does not allow a key of a table after the header of one of its sub-tables. Strings with line breaks are written as multi-line strings. Arrays that contain tables together with other values are written with inline tables. [b]Note:[/b] TOML has no [code]null[/code]. [code]null[/code] is written as an empty string [code]""[/code]; when a resource is loaded, an empty string sets an object property to [code]null[/code] and keeps the default value of a number or [bool] property. [b]Resource and files:[/b] [TOML] is a [Resource] (see [TextDataFormat]). [code]load("res://x.toml")[/code] of a plain file returns an instance, while files with a [code]$type[/code] marker load as the serialized resource. Plain files load with the project default options. The instance methods [method TextDataFormat.load] and [method TextDataFormat.save] work like [method ConfigFile.load] and [method ConfigFile.save]: they do not use the resource cache and do not set [member Resource.resource_path]. In exported games [code]res://[/code] is read-only, so save to [code]user://[/code]. [b]Changes:[/b] changing the data ([member TextDataFormat.data] in the inspector, [member TextDataFormat.data], [method set_value], [method erase_table] ...) drops the kept parsed text, so comments and formatting of the file are lost on the next save. [member TextDataFormat.options] set to [code]null[/code] uses the project settings. [b]Paths:[/b] a table path is dotted ([code]"window.size"[/code]); the empty path [code]""[/code] is the root table. A table name that contains [code].[/code] or [code]\[/code] is escaped with [code]\[/code] in the path ([code]"a\.b"[/code] is the one table [code]a.b[/code]). [codeblocks] [gdscript] var toml = TOML.new() toml.set_value("window", "width", 1280) toml.set_value("window.mode", "fullscreen", false) toml.save("user://settings.toml") print(toml.get_value("window", "width")) # Prints 1280 [/gdscript] [csharp] var toml = new Toml(); toml.SetValue("window", "width", 1280); toml.SetValue("window.mode", "fullscreen", false); toml.Save("user://settings.toml"); GD.Print(toml.GetValue("window", "width")); // Prints 1280 [/csharp] [/codeblocks] [b]Note:[/b] The static methods can be called from any thread. A [TOML] instance should be used by one thread at a time.

method.name: deserialize
method.description: Creates a resource from TOML [param text]. The class comes from the key [code]"$type"[/code] of the root table, or from [param type_hint]. Missing keys keep the default value of the class; unknown keys are skipped with a warning. Returns [code]null[/code] and prints an error if the text can't be read. [param options] is accepted for symmetry with [method ResourceTextSerializer.deserialize]; reading TOML has no options yet. The same as [code]ResourceTextSerializer.deserialize(text, ResourceTextSerializer.FORMAT_TOML, type_hint, options)[/code].

method.name: erase_table
method.description: Erases the table at [param table_path] with all its keys and sub-tables. Prints an error if it does not exist; the root table can't be erased (use [method TextDataFormat.clear]). Drops the kept parsed text.

method.name: erase_table_key
method.description: Erases the key [param key] of the table at [param table_path]. Prints an error if it does not exist. Drops the kept parsed text.

method.name: get_table_keys
method.description: Returns the keys of the table at [param table_path] in file order, or an empty array if the table does not exist.

method.name: get_tables
method.description: Returns the dotted paths of all tables, including nested ones, in file order. The root table is not included. Names with [code].[/code] or [code]\[/code] are escaped as described in the class description.

method.name: get_value
method.description: Returns the value of [param key] in the table at [param table_path], or [param default] if the table or key does not exist. Use [code]""[/code] as [param table_path] for the root table.

method.name: has_table
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the table at [param table_path] exists.

method.name: has_table_key
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the table at [param table_path] has the key [param key].

method.name: parse_string
method.description: Reads the TOML document [param text] and returns it as a [Dictionary]. Returns an empty [Dictionary] and prints an error with line and column if the text is not valid TOML.

method.name: serialize
method.description: Returns [param resource] as TOML text, with the same property mapping as the JSON format of [ResourceTextSerializer]. Of [param options], [member SerializerOptions.enums_as_names], [member SerializerOptions.defaults], [member SerializerOptions.include_type_marker], [member SerializerOptions.sort_keys] and [member SerializerOptions.full_precision_floats] apply; TOML ignores [member SerializerOptions.indent]. [code]null[/code] uses the project settings under [code]filesystem/resources/text_formats/[/code]. Returns an empty string and prints an error if the resource can't be written, for example if it contains itself. The same as [code]ResourceTextSerializer.serialize(resource, ResourceTextSerializer.FORMAT_TOML, options)[/code].

method.name: set_value
method.description: Sets the value of [param key] in the table at [param table_path]; missing tables are created. TOML has no [code]null[/code], so a [code]null[/code] [param value] erases the key. Use [code]""[/code] as [param table_path] for the root table. Drops the kept parsed text.

method.name: stringify
method.description: Returns [param data] as a TOML document. Values can be [bool], [int], [float], [String], [StringName], [NodePath], [Array], packed arrays and [Dictionary]; [code]null[/code] is written as [code]""[/code]. Returns an empty string and prints an error for other types (for example [Vector2] or [Object]) and for containers that contain themselves. [codeblocks] [gdscript] var text = TOML.stringify({ "name": "Game", "window": { "width": 1280 } }) # name = "Game" # # [window] # width = 1280 [/gdscript] [csharp] string text = Toml.Stringify(new Godot.Collections.Dictionary { { "name", "Game" }, { "window", new Godot.Collections.Dictionary { { "width", 1280 } } } }); [/csharp] [/codeblocks]
